subject: Jack Grealish dropped by Everton for a breach of discipline, then apologises on Instagram
title: Grealish: dropped, then sorry

lines.vo: Seven games, no goals, no assists, and one very public apology.
Jack Grealish was dropped by Everton for a breach of club discipline. The club has not said more, so neither will we.
He missed four matches, then came back in a friendly against Derby. Behind closed doors. Nobody saw the comeback, because the doors were closed.
He is on a second straight loan from Manchester City. Seven appearances, and the goals and assists column is a perfect row of zeros.
He apologised on Instagram. He said he could not help the team in recent weeks. Honest, at least. And unlike the comeback, the apology was open to the public.

facts_used: Everton left Grealish out of the 29 October Carabao Cup game for a breach of club discipline (ev0126)
He returned on 12 November in a behind-closed-doors friendly against Derby and apologised on Instagram (ev0126)
Second straight loan from Manchester City; no goals or assists in seven appearances this season (ev0126)
Missed four matches after the club discipline breach (ev0126)
